treatment: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor; Antipsychotic; Benzodiazepine; Cognitive behavioral therapy
uncurated_metadata: 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females were studied using shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics; AN patients were diagnosed by an experienced consultant psychiatrist meeting DSM-5 criteria for restricting or binge/purging subtypes; Only Danish Caucasian women were included due to ethnicity affecting gut microbiota; Faecal microbiota transplantation was performed from three AN-RS cases and three HC participants to germ-free female Swiss Webster mice; Mice were subjected to a 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks after FMT; Study protocol registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384)
